title: Row count bound by the squared scale
statement: Let $k,n,N,D$ be nonnegative integers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $0<N$, and $2N\le D$. Define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, $s=\lceil nD/N\rceil$, and $r=(k-1)d+1$. Then $r\le 4(s+1)^2$.
